response.note: Computes the percentage of October 2026 orders with attempt_count greater than 1 from v_orders.
response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_attempt_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attempt_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS multi_attempt_pct FROM v_orders WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
